This is a work about "love" and "patience"
The most "different" love memoir will be launched on the STEAM platform. The new love simulation full-motion live-action interactive video work "Please! Please Confess First" is officially released on the STEAM platform! The story unfolds a heart-warming story from the first-person perspective with "unemployed youth Hao Xingchen" as the background of the story. 6 heroines with different personalities, different experiences, and different styles appear in your life. "Love what you choose, choose what you love" a love journey of life is waiting for you to experience!

The story is not long, but it is unforgettable .

This is a game that carries the "past" of every boy

This is a game that feels "different"

This is also the shadow of "every girl" at different stages

This is a game interactive drama with a "taste of memory"

This is not just a game interactive drama, perhaps "it" is the past that you can't forget!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45304270/8b03d245756a075cfaed1d2190f5b329056291a2.jpg[/img]

In "Please! Please confess first", you will have a wonderful experience with 6 girls, including the first love of the rabbit, Xia Lin, the caring "good friend" of the bear, Zhao Qiqi, the mysterious sister of the fox, Wu Mengling, the domineering little princess of the cat, Shen Xingyue, the soft and sticky little girl of the dog, and the little girl of the dog. Sister Zhizhi, hedgehog-style "defensive" cool girl Annie, what kind of life and growth experience has created these girls with different personalities? You need to experience it slowly. Every look, every information point, every expression of every sentence, every interaction, happy, sad, happy... are so real! Listen to your inner voice and make your own choice!

Innovative gameplay, in the world of "Please! Please Confess First", we provide psychological tests, and the direction of each player is completely different. The test results are also completely different. We also have a gift-giving session in the game, and you can express your feelings in a specific plot! Every time you collect clues, there are the girl's past and experience, which will let you see different "them". We provide exclusive ringtones, players can choose their favorite heroines and listen to their comments to you. Our exclusive expression!

You may not be brilliant
But you are always warm and bright

Perhaps in the low period of life, everyone will question whether they are "unworthy", "not good enough" or "not worth it", but perhaps this is not the truth. No one in this world will fall in love with someone "for no reason". Maybe even you yourself have never found that when you are shining, you quietly illuminate and melt the hearts of others. When you are immersed in the game and become the male protagonist, please feel every expression of "Hao Xingchen" with your heart, feel his sincerity, his delicacy, his courage, his helplessness, his happiness, his uneasiness, his past...
Everyone is rich, and feel that "every step" has its meaning. No matter what choice you make, it is the best decision you made at the time.

Hello, this is "Please! Please confess first" welcome home.
